dedup_rule.applicability: decided only on files whose every row carries a content_sha256 and a millisecond ts; the legacy schema (no content_sha256, one-second ts_utc) is not_applicable and is NOT de-duplicated
dedup_rule.rule: identical (ts, content_sha256, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens) within one file; first occurrence kept, the rest are excess (TVS-REGRADE duplicate_rows.rule)

disputed_rule.deciding_measurement: a request_sha256 recorded on future rows, or a writer-level double-append proof

estimability_floor.enforced: a p95 is published only when BOTH n_raw and n_dedup reach 60 AND the analyser produced a point with an interval; otherwise the cell is refused by name with both counts quoted

floor_policy.applied_to: every cell, both p50 and p95 columns; p95 only
